rationale: wu_2015_trainable-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=6, wu_n_outer=2, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, epochs=12, batch_size=1, lr=7e-05, weight_decay=0.0, loss_base=mse, lambda_neg=0.7, wu_soft_thresh=0.0008, wu_sigmoid_slope=1.5, wu_sigmoid_offset=1.0, wu_band_scale=1.0, wu_residual_blend=1.0, train_n=600, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-20 (FINAL, one knob vs iter-19 best). FAILURE MODE: at the ultra-low-param ceiling but a softer band-overlap keeps lifting hr; peak not yet bracketed on the shallow side. ONE KNOB: wu_sigmoid_slope 2.5 -> 1.5 (INIT, NO param change, 12 params). HYPOTHESIS: if slope=1.5 gives hr > 0.31130 the shallow trend continues toward a broad max; if hr < 0.31130 the sigmoid_slope optimum brackets near 2.5 and iter-19 (hr=0.3113) is the campaign best. Either way this HARD-STOP iter-20 closes the six-box search with the slope axis characterized. Budget: ~735s.
